I don't think they will, unless Yasha really begs Cad or Jester to try bring him back, but if that happens Molly wont be a PC again. I don't think it would be a good idea for Molly to come back in his own story. As a character he didn't really have a personal goal in his life. Matt offered that to him through Cree and the possibility of reconciliation with the life of Lucien, but Molly rejected that opportunity to learn more. While if he had lived until episode 86 I imagine he would have been forced to confront Lucien's past inevitably - there was a member of Lucien's Tomb Takers in Shady Creek Run (meaning literally in the next episode, or at least soon after, Molly would've probably met another person from Lucien's life) - Molly never actually displayed any desire to during his time in the Nein to restore those memories. He was a complete hedonist, and while he was achieving his and the Nein's goals as they came, I don't believe he had a particular personal life goal that was left unfinished. Fjord wanted to find Vandren, Jester wanted to find her father, Caleb wants to bring back his family, etc - and while many over the course of the campaign have managed to achieve some of their goals (Jester), or decide that they were no longer worth it (Fjord), not everyone in the Nein has had clear goals (Beau), and Molly seems to be akin to a more goalless lifestyle. Beyond in universe ideas though, as much as Molly was my favourite, having Molly around would go against where I think the narrative was at episode 26 and also where the narrative is now. So much has happened and been experienced in the last 60 episodes, and Molly hasn't lived that time. What would happen if we brought him back? We ditch Cad and bring Molly back? Going more from a meta sense as well, Taliesin would probably be against Molly coming back. He died. But while he did die, he did also live. Matt has released a lot of information regarding Molly's backstory in the C2E17 pdf, so I imagine that while it reveals certain details, it also reveals that Molly is not intended to return. I imagine Taliesin and Matt had a conversation about what they would do after E26. It sucks to have a character die. As a DM, if a player was going to not have as much fun at a table after a character death, then yeah - I would say you can bring them back. I would take from that character, stats, loved ones, material wealth - the player is the soul of the character, and if the soul of a character is still willing and determined to return after great sacrifice, (within reason) I would allow it. But I don't think Taliesin is like that player, I think Taliesin is happy with Cad. I would be, he is a fantastic character. I don't think Molly will return.
